beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: At that last supper, knowing he was about to leave the world, Jesus did something no master would ever do for his servants.

timing.text: At that last supper, knowing he was about to leave the world, Jesus did something no master would ever do for his servants.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He got up from the table, wrapped a towel around his waist, and poured water into a basin.

timing.text: He got up from the table, wrapped a towel around his waist, and poured water into a basin.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: And he began to wash his disciples' feet — one by one.

timing.text: And he began to wash his disciples' feet — one by one.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When he came to Peter, Peter pulled back.

timing.text: When he came to Peter, Peter pulled back.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: Thou shalt never wash my feet.

timing.text: Thou shalt never wash my feet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Not you. Not for me, Peter said. And Jesus answered him gently, but he did not back down.

timing.text: And Jesus answered him gently, but he did not back down.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

timing.text: If I wash thee not, thou hast no part with me.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: That is how serious this is. Peter thought he was protecting Jesus's dignity. What he was really doing was refusing to be loved.

timing.text: That is how serious this is.
Peter thought he was protecting Jesus's dignity.
What he was really doing was refusing to be loved.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: When he had finished, he dried their feet with the towel at his waist, sat back down, and asked if they understood what he had just done.

timing.text: When he had finished, he dried their feet with the towel at his waist, sat back down, and asked if they understood what he had just done.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

timing.text: If I then, your Lord and Master, have washed your feet; ye also ought to wash one another's feet.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Whatever he just did for them, they were to go do for each other.

timing.text: Whatever he just did for them, they were to go do for each other.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The greatest one in the room knelt at the dirtiest job in the house. That is the kind of king he is.

timing.text: The greatest one in the room knelt at the dirtiest job in the house.
That is the kind of king he is.

card.text: He kneels to serve the ones he loves. Will you let him near enough to do it for you?
